method: R2.6 deliberate burst: 30 concurrent tiny chat-completions against https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 (the Coding-Plan-billed endpoint) with the slot key from the keystore; 16 of 75 requests answered 429 across three waves. Body captured verbatim; no secret appears in it.
notes: z.ai codes its rate limit 1302 inside an HTTP 429. The opencode envelope carries it as error.response.body (stringified), status 429 — classified quota/rate_limit by HTTP status before the body is even parsed.
